C1294.title: MCP Tool Poisoning Attack: Malicious Server Manipulates Tool Descriptions to Hijack Authentication
C1294.summary: A security threat disclosed in May 2025 reveals that malicious MCP servers can tamper with tool descriptions to launch attacks. When multiple servers connect to the same client, a rogue server can poison tool descriptions, steal data from other trusted servers, and hijack authentication by transferring credentials from one server to another.
